rationale: Deadline cut to 11 days: the ocean sailing (34 days) and sea-air (16-day ocean leg to DXB) cannot make it, so every plan must be air. The cheapest air plan should cost 22,000-32,000 USD and, with days of slack, be on time with probability above 0.9.
falsifier: Refuted if any named plan uses an ocean leg, if the cost-optimal cost falls outside 22,000-32,000 USD, or if its on-time probability is 0.9 or lower.
